cli.finalMessage:
Built the delivery address form in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Details:
- Fields: full name, phone, emirate (select with the 7 UAE emirates), area, building, flat number, delivery notes — name/phone/emirate/area marked required with `*` and validated.
- Mock data (`MOCK_FORM`) has phone empty and flat number set to `"12/B!"` (fails the flat-number pattern), with `submitted` initialized to `true`, so those two errors render immediately while the rest of the form shows valid mock values.
- Errors are shown with `role="alert"`, `aria-invalid`, and `aria-describedby` wiring.
- CSS uses the `--strata-*` design tokens already referenced in `src/app.css` (with sensible fallback values) and logical properties (`inline`/`block`, `margin-inline`, etc.) so it adapts to the right-to-left Arabic locale.
- No `@strata/react` components were used since neither `node_modules` nor type declarations for that package exist in this folder, so I couldn't verify its API; plain semantic HTML form controls styled with the confirmed design tokens avoid guessing an incorrect component API while still matching the visual system.

I didn't touch `src/main.tsx`, `src/app.css`, `package.json`, or config files, and worked only within this folder.
